description: This file implements logging and buffer management for audio data in the Android Open Source Project, including classes BufLog, BufLogStream, and singleton BufLogSingleton, with functions for writing, resetting, and managing audio buffer logs.

classes.name: BufLog
classes.description: Manages multiple BufLogStream instances, providing methods to write logs and reset streams.

classes.name: BufLogStream
classes.description: Handles individual audio buffer log streams, including file creation, writing data, and stream control.

classes.name: BufLogSingleton
classes.description: Singleton class providing global access to a BufLog instance with thread-safe initialization.

methods.name: BufLog::write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified buffer stream, creating the stream if it does not exist.

methods.name: BufLog::reset
methods.description: Resets all buffer streams, closing and deleting them.

methods.name: BufLogStream::write
methods.description: Writes data to the buffer stream's file, respecting pause state and maximum byte limit.

methods.name: BufLogStream::closeStream_l
methods.description: Closes the file associated with the buffer stream.

methods.name: BufLogStream::setPause
methods.description: Sets the pause state of the buffer stream.

methods.name: BufLogStream::finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the buffer stream by closing its file.

methods.name: BufLogSingleton::initOnce
methods.description: Initializes the singleton instance of BufLog.

methods.name: BufLogSingleton::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of BufLog, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: BufLogSingleton::instanceExists
methods.description: Checks if the singleton BufLog instance exists.
